Docs.summary: The classes in this package are used for development of accessibility service that provide alternative or augmented feedback to the user.

remarks.para: Derive from to implement an accessibility service. Use to configure event types, feedback types, flags, notification timeouts, and package filters. Declare the service's capabilities and other settings in its metadata.

The namespace also includes controllers for magnification, the soft keyboard, fingerprint gestures, touch interaction, and Braille displays. represents gestures that an accessibility service can dispatch, and provides APIs for text editing.
